description: Details required by condition 6 (Trees and landscaping) of planningÿpermission 23/01178  (Recovering of butterfly roof in genuine slate and lead; new solar thermal/photovoltaic panels and conservation access rooflight to butterfly roof; new double height glazed rear extension, all in painted metal; re-constructed and extended closet wing to match height and depth of neighbours at No.32, (with low profile rooflight); adjustments to fenestration including replacement of lower ground floor Front window; internal adjustments to openings in partitions and door openings; removal of later applied mouldings internally; lowering floor level to ancillary space under front steps; conversion of 1No Vault into Utility including lowering floor level; alterations to front garden including reconstruction of front steps and landing, reconstruction of steps to lightwell, new/repositioned ironwork to match original and minor adjustments to paving surfaces; rear garden landscaping including reconstructed steps to terrace, extended lower terrace, and new rear paved seating area)
